lint.title: x402 Endpoint Lint & Listing Guard | Passive 402 Checks

url.title: Public endpoint URL
url.description: Public HTTPS only, no credentials, fragment or private network. Our request is unpaid GET; the advertised method goes only to CDP validation.

method.title: Advertised method
method.description: Method to validate; no paid execution or target POST.

lint.description: Inspect public HTTPS x402 endpoints with an unpaid GET. Export quote options, passive security coverage, CDP technical validation, listing-risk score, flagged spans and rewrite guidance. No payment, target POST or safety certification.

receipt.title: USDC Payment Receipt on Base | Signed Transfer Verification

tx_hash.title: Base transaction hash
tx_hash.description: Successful native Base USDC transfer transaction. Use a log index when multiple transfers occur. The prefilled hash is a public operator-owned historical example; replace it for your own receipt.

pay_to.title: Alternative recipient address
pay_to.description: Alternative lookup mode: supply pay_to + exact amount + start/end, without tx_hash/log_index.

amount.title: Exact USDC amount
amount.description: Decimal USDC, max6 fractional digits; alternative recipient/window lookup only.

start.title: Window start (UTC ISO)
start.description: Alternative mode, inclusive start; past window, max90days.

end.title: Window end (UTC ISO)
end.description: Exclusive end, not future. Multiple matches fail rather than guessing.

receipt.description: Verify a native USDC transfer on Base from a transaction hash or recipient, amount and time window. Get signed JSON, a printable HTML receipt, L2 confirmations and OFAC address-match flags. Read-only; no wallet or funds movement.

statement.title: USDC Wallet Statement on Base | CSV & JSON Export

address.title: Public Base address
address.description: 0x +40 hex digits. Native Circle USDC only, not bridged USDbC. The prefilled address/window is a public operator-owned one-day historical example; replace all three fields for your own statement.

start.title: Start (UTC ISO, inclusive)
start.description: Past ISO8601 time. Maximum90days, half-open range.

end.title: End (UTC ISO, exclusive)
end.description: Must follow start and not be in the future. Narrow large ranges when RPC limits are reached.

statement.description: Export native USDC transactions for a public Base wallet as JSON and CSV. Includes incoming, outgoing and self transfers, running balances, counterparties and OFAC flags within a past window of up to 90 days. Read-only; not tax advice.

token.title: Base Token Safety Check | Contract Risk Signals

address.title: Public Base contract address
address.description: One public Base mainnet address. Supply a contract address for deep observations. No wallet or RPC credentials.

chain.title: Chain
chain.description: Base mainnet only; no network auto-detection.

token.description: Inspect a Base token contract for bytecode, OFAC address matches, owner/paused/proxy observations and bounded source/deployment evidence. Read-only contract signals with explicit unknowns; no honeypot test, sellability check or safe-to-buy verdict.
